audience: clinics and practices that book appointments in Progenda

useCases.title: See the appointments in a calendar
useCases.text: List the calendars your user can access. Then list the appointments of one calendar for a time window, and open one to read its details.

useCases.title: Find open slots for a service
useCases.text: Pick a calendar and a service, then ask for the suggested open slots for that service in the calendar.

useCases.title: Book an appointment for a patient
useCases.text: Find the service in the calendar. Then create the appointment for the patient's remote id, under your own remote id for the appointment.

useCases.title: Move or cancel an appointment
useCases.text: Find the appointment by your remote id. Change its time, or set its status to booked, cancelled or no-show.
